notes: Reason code function (Step 1, item 5): the learned VQ-C network (LSTM plus VQ-VAE) learns BS beamforming and RIS codebooks and selects codewords, but only as the sensing strategy of a localization problem. Its loss and its main metric are the position error: p. 5: "the goal of the localization problem is to estimate the unknown user position p"; p. 8: "MSE loss is used to minimize the average MSE between the estimated position"; p. 10: "localization performance in terms of root-mean-squared error (RMSE)".
